mapper.sql: SELECT id, product_key, device_id, tsl_json, tsl_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM product
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_key, device_id, tsl_json, tsl_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{productKey}, #{deviceId}, #{tslJson}, #{tslVersion}, #{createBy}, SYSDATE(), #{updateBy}, SYSDATE(), 0)

INSERT INTO product (product_key, device_id, tsl_json, tsl_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{productKey}, #{deviceId}, #{tslJson}, #{tslVersion}, #{createBy}, SYSDATE(), #{updateBy}, SYSDATE(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tsl_json = VALUES(tsl_json), tsl_version = VALUES(tsl_version), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = SYSDATE()
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_key = CONCAT(product_key, '#DEL#', device_id), del_flag = 1, update_time = SYSDATE() WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE del_flag = 0
